name: Makino Takaha
source:
Takaha does an efficient job of following orders and making others follow her orders. She made initial encounter with the protagonist through a minor altercation and misunderstanding, but made such a powerful impression, he asked her to his security guard and enforcer. Takaha's antisocial nature and tendency to speak her mind makes it difficult to get along with her, and she has very few people to call friends.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20070211064835/www.elizar.com/?p=7]Nargrakhan's review[/url]]
